whyUs.title: Source Integrity
whyUs.body: Transparent supply chains with direct farmer partnerships across Kerala, Rajasthan, Gujarat, and major spice belts.

whyUs.title: Grade-Certified
whyUs.body: All products meet FSSAI standards. Organic-certified and export-grade variants available with full documentation.

whyUs.title: Pan-India Reach
whyUs.body: From Kashmir to Kanyakumari, our distribution network ensures reliable, timely delivery across the country.

process.title: Sourcing
process.body: Direct procurement from certified farms and cooperatives.

process.title: Quality Check
process.body: Lab testing for purity, moisture, and grade compliance.

process.title: Processing
process.body: Cleaning, grading, and processing in certified facilities.

process.title: Packaging
process.body: Custom bulk, retail, or private label packaging.

process.title: Delivery
process.body: Fast, tracked dispatch across all Indian states.
